card.name: Digits inside numbers starting with 2
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a number that begins with 2, such as 25_ or 20-24._ or 2._, usually right before a unit like mg/dL, mcg/mL, mL, IU or GHz.

modes.label: Third digit after 25
modes.description: The last digit of a number like 250 or 256 just before a unit or the word million.
modes.example: Withhold PADCEV if blood glucose is >25<<0>> mg/dL.

modes.label: Decimal digit after 20-24.
modes.description: The digit after the decimal point in a drug level range such as 20-24.9 mcg/mL, or a frequency like 2.4 GHz.

card.plain: It lights up on the final digit of numbers in the 20s and 250s, like 250 mg/dL or 24.9 mcg/mL.
